items.where: the two arcade warehouses (s 12-48, 58-97): three tiers of giant round arches over steel-framed glazing, four storeys, two and two, with floor transoms
items.how: a tall framed opening per bay and tier with transom bars, a glass half-disc head, white impost blocks and keystone; tier springings at 9.8, 15.95 and 21.2 m (re-read 2026-11-23)

items.where: two white stone cornices across the arcade warehouses at the tier lines (12.6 m and 18.6 m)
four dark grey glazed oriel stacks on the pilaster blocks, third storey to the roof, 7-8 m wide
items.how: a box 0.7 m proud in the oriel grey with glass panes per storey, a dark frame grid over the glass (mullions between panes, a spandrel rail and a transom per storey) and a brick pilaster strip at each side (2026-11-23)

items.where: the pilaster blocks (s 107-144, 154-192): two-storey ground arcade of small round-headed windows, white band, white-blocked windows, cornice, recessed window strips with grey spandrel panels and Juliet rails, attic of small arches
items.how: one column per 1.85 m: ground and arched windows, recessed strip with grey back and glass slabs, white blocks and bands; the attic arches as glass half-discs

items.where: a two-storey passage under the first oriel of the west pilaster block
two low two-storey links with a garage door each between the blocks
